notes: v6.4.4 - Fixes from a real field test: (1) Text Animations apply again - a build fault made every animation fail at the fallback step; failed tries now clean up after themselves and the panel reports the first real error. (2) Song Finder's 'Find the song' button works again - it was silently dead since v6.4 (a missing helper); it now answers instantly, and any future hiccup shows a message instead of silence. (3) Blue Emoji colour copies import correctly again (same missing helper). (4) Settings shows your theme's real name. (5) SFX Trending ends with a Refreshed tick. Your settings, keys and PRO unlock carry over.
